convention: UTC calendar days, both ends inclusive. Cut indices floor(0.6*1004)=602 and floor(0.8*1004)=803 (0-based day index). The first day of the VERDICT segment and the first day of the HOLDOUT segment are the 1-day embargo days and belong to no segment.

download_guard.rule: No file whose covered dates extend past max_allowed_date may be requested or opened (monthly files for 2026-03 and later are therefore refused). Unlock only after the VERDICT result is committed and Shawn approves (PREREG §3, §11c).
